subject: Commit curve & accelerator credits — MAP and monthly TPM ramp
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@signalfleet.com>

Cc: SignalFleet Procurement <procurement@signalfleet.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: MAP & target TPMs

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the latency and cost breakdowns were very helpful. We have internal momentum to move from evaluation to a pilot, but procurement and engineering need a clear MAP (mutual action plan) tied to pricing and commit milestones.

High level asks from our side:
- A 3–6 week evaluation plan with measurable success criteria (latency SLA, token throughput, cost/unit).
- A proposed monthly TPM ramp (month-by-month targets) and the commercial discounts that apply at each milestone.
- Any accelerator or onboarding credits you can offer to shorten time-to-value.

Rough internal targets (for context):
- Pilot month (M1): ~50M tokens
- M2: 150M tokens
- M3: 400M tokens (expected full feature rollout)

Can you send a MAP draft + SOW that ties discounts to commits? We need this by EOD Friday to feed procurement.

Thanks,
Sarah

SignalFleet

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 14:03:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: MAP & target TPMs

Hi Sarah — great to hear there's momentum. I've attached a draft MAP and an initial SOW that maps commercial milestones to month-over-month TPM commitments. Key points up front:

- Evaluation plan: 3-week technical POC (workloads instrumented via our SDK + integration checklist). Success criteria include median p50 latency < 250ms for 2k-5k token sequences, end-to-end throughput to sustain 10 req/s with continuous KV cache, and a quality baseline against your 500 prompt eval set.

- Proposed commit curve (baseline offer):
  M1: 40M tokens (intro credit applied)
  M2: 175M tokens
  M3: 350M tokens
  M4+: 500M tokens/month steady state

- Pricing & discounts: list price $0.0045 / 1k tokens. Discount bands applied once month-over-month commits hit thresholds for two consecutive months:
  - >=150M TPM: 10% off list
  - >=350M TPM: 18% off list
  - >=500M TPM: 26% off list

- Accelerator: one-time onboarding credit equal to 25% of M1 committed spend if you sign the MAP and SOW within the next 21 days.

I attached Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf and SOW_SignalFleet_v2.docx. Ben is cc'ed to propose an alternate ramp/credit structure if you want a faster acceleration.

Would you like to set a quick alignment call today at 4pm PT to walk procurement through the MAP?

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf (12 pages), SOW_SignalFleet_v2.docx (4 pages)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Looping in a quick counter that has worked for other fleets: Hannah's baseline is conservative — if SignalFleet can commit to a steeper ramp we can provide an "accelerator package."

Alternate ramp (accelerator):
  M1: 75M tokens (50% onboarding credit applied to token charges)
  M2: 225M tokens
  M3: 425M tokens
  M4: 700M tokens

Commercial changes with accelerator:
- Faster discount vesting: 150M band applies after M2; 350M after M3.
- Additional $25k one-time adoption credit for tooling/integration if you include a 12-month committed term.

Notes: this requires procurement to commit to a 12-month minimum and a 30-day notice for downscale. Happy to draft the exact redline language in the SOW.

—Ben

Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah and Ben — appreciate the clear options. A few clarifications from procurement/engineering:

- We prefer the accelerator path but need a smaller initial commercial commitment. Can you do:
  M1: 60M tokens (with 40% onboarding credit)
  M2: 200M tokens
  M3: 450M tokens
  M4: 650M tokens

- The one-time adoption credit looks good, but procurement wants it split: $10k integration credit + $15k usage credit redeemable across M1–M3.
- We need a SOC 2 type II evidence pack and data handling appendix before legal signs the MAP/SOW.
- Procurement has an internal deadline of 2026-07-30 for kickoff approval.

If you can update the SOW with the split credit and the SOC 2 appendix, we can move to signatures.

Regards,
Sarah

Sarah — thanks for the counter. We've updated the SOW and commercial terms to reflect your requests. Summary of final offer (attached SOW_SignalFleet_v2.docx):

- Commit curve (agreed):
  M1: 60M tokens (list-equivalent spend; 40% onboarding credit applied to token charges)
  M2: 200M tokens
  M3: 450M tokens
  M4+: 650M tokens/month steady state

- Pricing (post-credit effective rates):
  - List: $0.0045 / 1k tokens
  - Effective pricing with credits applied: est. $0.0027 / 1k tokens for M1, then tiered discounts: 12% @>=150M, 20% @>=350M, 28% @>=650M

- One-time adoption credit split as requested: $10k integration services credit + $15k usage credit (redeemable across M1–M3).
- Contract term: 12 months; 30-day downscale notice.
- Deliverables: 3-week POC plan, technical checklist, SOC 2 appendix (included).

Next steps:
1) I will upload the SOW with redlines to the HubSpot record and push a DocuSign envelope for signatures (link below).
2) Procurement to confirm SOC2 checklist items; we will provide the evidence pack (SOC 2 type II summary, data retention policy, and KMS integration guide).
3) Kickoff scheduled within 5 business days of signature.
